description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEvaluationAPI class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. The class handles API endpoints for retrieving and updating performance review evaluations for employees, including functionalities like getting review data, reviewer ratings, allowed actions, and updating review statuses. It extends the SupervisorEvaluationAPI class and integrates with various performance review and reviewer entities and models.

classes.name: EmployeeEvaluationAPI
classes.description: This class handles API interactions related to employee performance evaluations and reviews within the OrangeHRM platform, extending supervisor capabilities with specific employee-focused functionalities. It manages retrieval of review data, reviewer ratings, permissible actions, and updating review statuses and comments.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves the performance review data for an employee, including ratings, comments, reviewer info, and allowed actions.

methods.name: getReviewerRatings
methods.description: Fetches reviewer ratings for a specific evaluation based on provided search filters.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts the number of reviewer ratings for a specific evaluation.

methods.name: getReviewerForReviewRating
methods.description: Returns reviewer information associated with a review, normalized for API response.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Determines and normalizes the list of allowed actions a user can take on a performance review.

methods.name: getAllowedActionList
methods.description: Provides the specific list of permissible state transitions based on the current review status and user role.

methods.name: setReviewRatingsParams
methods.description: Saves review ratings submitted through the API request.

methods.name: checkActionAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if the current user is permitted to perform actions on the review based on its state and permissions.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates the reviewer's completion status based on the API input.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the reviewer comment on a performance review, if provided.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules schema for updating a review, including whether the review is marked as complete.
